title: 第15章 不如把人全杀了吧第16章 试炼的规则
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
“嘶——！”
“他……他竟然敢对勇者大人动手？！”
“疯了！这小子绝对疯了！”
……
围观的民众和冒险者发出难以置信的惊呼。
在圣木帝国，勇者的地位超然。
当众殴打勇者，无疑是重罪！
锵！锵！锵！
反应过来的城门守卫们脸色剧变。
毫不犹豫地纷纷拔出了腰间的长剑和长矛。
瞬间就将林默围在了中央。
锋利的兵刃闪烁着寒光，对准了他。
气氛骤然变得剑拔弩张。
城主法诺的脸色也彻底沉了下来。
他上前一步，不再掩饰自身的气息。
一股沉重如山岳般的威压骤然以他为中心扩散开来。
空气仿佛都凝滞了几分。
这是属于20级强者的气势，远非10级冒险者可比！
林默身处这股气势的中心，眉头微不可察地皱紧。
他清晰地感觉到身体变得有些迟滞，呼吸也略显不畅。

“这家伙的实力……不简单。”
他心中暗道。
“看来10级之后的每次突破，获得的属性增长远超之前，否则，以我如今超过三百的全属性，不至于有如此明显的压迫感。”
法诺目光冰冷地锁定林默。
声音带着不容置疑的威严：“你，触犯了圣木帝国的律法，公然袭击勇者。我现在要以城主的名义，将你逮捕，带回城主府受审！”
这时，王同也挣扎着从地上爬了起来。
他头发散乱，脸上还有一个清晰的红印，显得狼狈不堪。
他躲到法诺身后，指着林默，气急败坏地尖声咒骂：“混蛋！竟敢打我！城主大人，快把他抓起来！不，就地正法！杀了他！”
林默的眉头皱得更深了。
握住黑剑剑柄的手微微收紧。
他不喜欢麻烦，但如果麻烦非要找上门，他也不会坐以待毙。
content_en:
"Hiss——!"
"He...he dared to attack the brave man?!"
"Crazy! This kid is absolutely crazy!"
…
The onlookers and adventurers exclaimed in disbelief.
In the Holy Wood Empire, the status of the brave is transcendent.
Beating a brave man in public is undoubtedly a serious crime!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The faces of the city gate guards changed dramatically after they reacted.
Without hesitation, they all drew out their swords and spears from their waists.
Lin Mo was immediately surrounded in the center.
The sharp blade flashed with cold light and was aimed at him.
The atmosphere suddenly became tense.
City Lord Fano's face also completely darkened.
He took a step forward and no longer concealed his aura.
A pressure as heavy as a mountain suddenly spread around him.
The air seemed to be stagnant.
This is the momentum that belongs to a level 20 strong person, far beyond the comparison of a level 10 adventurer!
Lin Mo was at the center of this momentum, his brows furrowed imperceptibly.
He clearly felt that his body had become a little sluggish and his breathing was slightly unsmooth.
"This guy's strength...is not simple."
He thought to himself.
"It seems that every time I break through after level 10, the attributes gained are much higher than before. Otherwise, with my current attributes of over 300, I wouldn't have such an obvious sense of oppression."
Fanuo locked eyes on Lin Mo with cold eyes.
The voice carried unquestionable majesty: "You have violated the laws of the Holy Wood Empire and openly attacked the brave. Now, in the name of the city lord, I will arrest you and take you back to the city lord's palace for trial!"
At this time, Wang Tong also struggled to get up from the ground.
His hair was disheveled and there was a clear red mark on his face, making him look miserable.
He hid behind Fano, pointed at Lin Mo, and cursed angrily: "Asshole! How dare you hit me! City Lord, arrest him quickly! No, punish him on the spot! Kill him!"
Lin Mo's frown deepened.
The hand holding the hilt of the black sword tightened slightly.
He doesn't like trouble, but if trouble comes, he won't sit still.
